sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by a general nervous hypersensitivity and a feeling of embarrassment and shyness. It is useful in cases of nervous disorders and digestive disturbances in elderly people. There is a general feeling of weakness and lack of vital force. The patient is often a thin, nervous person. There is a marked tendency to premature old age.
sections.Mind: Shy and embarrassed. Aversion to the presence of others. Confused and forgetful. Loquacity. Anxiety.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo on rising. Scalp feels tight.
sections.Eyes: Eyes red and burning. Dimness of vision.
sections.Mouth: Dryness of the mouth. Tongue feels dry and sticky. Foul breath.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Thirst. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Eructations.
sections.Rectum: Constipation. Stool large and hard. Frequent desire for stool.
sections.Urinary: Frequent desire to urinate. Scanty urine.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, ending in eructations. Hoarseness.
sections.Heart: Palpitation, with a sensation of oppression in the region of the heart.
sections.Extremities: Twitching and jerking of the muscles. Trembling of the hands. Numbness and tingling.
sections.Skin: Itching and burning. Dry and scaly.
sections.Modalities: Worse in the presence of others and in the morning. Better from open air and cold food.
